title: Alpine Level Quirks
doc: Per-level compatibility switches shipped with Alpine Faction; each line lists any number of quoted level file names.

alpine.notes: Alpine reads this file line by line, not with the game's table parser: lines are trimmed, everything before a line that is exactly #Start is ignored, reading stops at a line that is exactly #End, blank lines and lines starting with // are skipped, and every other line is 'name: value' split at the first colon. Field order does not matter, a later line overrides an earlier one, and unknown names are only logged. Comments after a value become part of the value.

sections.name: #Start
sections.doc: Options between #Start and #End, in any order.

fields.name: $P2T Fix:
fields.doc: Levels (quoted .rfl names) that get the power-of-two texture fix.

fields.name: $Known Run Maps:
fields.doc: Levels (quoted .rfl names) treated as known run maps.

fields.name: $Sky Fix:
fields.doc: Levels (quoted .rfl names) whose skybox faces lose the Show Sky flag.

fields.name: $Stock Alpha Test:
fields.doc: Levels (quoted .rfl names) that keep the stock alpha test threshold.
